items.title: Economics v2 — soft announce (design lock; not activated)
items.summary: Public RFC locks Economics v2 before any height switch: target 0.1 HMC/empty block, ~4-year halvings from genesis, permanent 0.002 HMC tail, no hard max-supply fiction, pool funded from emission (not perpetual treasury top-ups), clearer order fee/burn, SUP as utility. No airdrops. Activation only after D1 soak + published height with ≥14 days notice from tip — not a vanity block.
items.impact: Operators and miners: read the RFC. Live network stays on current rc18 economics until a later announced activation height. Dig/Hunt package prices unchanged by this RFC. Do not treat 0.1 HMC/block as live yet.

items.title: 0.1.0-rc18 — Blake3 share-PPS LIVE · CUDA/OpenCL · ISO channel
items.summary: Current release channel is 0.1.0-rc18. Public pool runs SHARE_STRICT share-PPS: verified Blake3 share_nonces (work % (M/1024) == 0) pay. Pool hashrate kind is blake3_pow_ghs (shares/wall). NVIDIA CUDA and AMD OpenCL Blake3 miners are supported (see BLAKE3_GPU_MATRIX). Dig/Hunt remain useful-work lanes; Hunt needs Linux+bwrap. Legacy soft-mode copy is retired.
items.impact: Upgrade workers/installers to 0.1.0-rc18. Dashboard What's new + miner notices match share-PPS. Historical rc17.x notes stay in the archive below.

items.title: Blake3 PoH LIVE — tip ≥ #485000 · honest ~few GH/s wall-rate
items.summary: Mainnet crossed the Blake3 gate at height 485000. Pool formula is blake3_v3(prev‖miner‖nonce_le)%M==0. Pool runs share-PPS (SHARE_STRICT): verified shares at M/1024; GH/s from shares/wall. Real PoW GH/s is wall-timed Blake3 throughput (~few GH/s fleet class) — not the pre-cliff hybrid algebraic calib. Dig/Hunt leases remain live. Economics v2 (emission lock, pool-from-emission, burn-on-orders) is upcoming RFC — not live numbers as gospel.
items.impact: Dashboard/site must show blake3_pow_ghs. Rebuild workerpoh so submit ghs= matches wall rate. Soft 429/no-work on fuzz is OK. Exchange: own paper desk D0 + listing pack ready; no foreign CEX listing claimed.
